note: Candidates only — not certified golden tests. No certification status changes in this PR.

candidates.title: Same label Consolidated EBITDA must not share formula across CHWY and CONMED
candidates.assertion: Compiler/evaluator treats CHWY and CONMED Consolidated EBITDA as distinct calculation graphs (different caps/add-backs).

candidates.title: FCCR formula divergence FWRG vs LSB
candidates.assertion: Retriever/compiler must not reuse FWRG FCCR arithmetic for LSB Payment Conditions gates.

candidates.title: Maintenance ratio thresholds are not baskets
candidates.assertion: CONMED §7.1 3.75x/5.50x/2.75x must classify as conditions/obligations, never FIXED_DOLLAR or grower capacity.

candidates.title: Missing financial inputs fail closed
candidates.assertion: Evaluating Total Leverage without attested covenant EBITDA and CTD components yields MISSING_INPUT, not a numeric ratio.

candidates.title: Cash netting cap amendment changes identity
candidates.assertion: CONMED leverage cash netting $75M vs $100M must version-bind; post-amendment math must not silently use pre-amendment cap.

candidates.title: Anti-duplication of add-backs
candidates.assertion: CHWY §1.08(d)(ii) prevents double counting Expected Run Rate / pro forma amounts already in Consolidated EBITDA.

candidates.title: Available Amount builder ≠ grower basket threshold
candidates.assertion: CHWY Asset Sale 75% Consolidated EBITDA exception threshold must not be merged into Available Amount builder capacity.

candidates.title: Step-up frequency and TLR ceiling
candidates.assertion: CONMED Material Acquisition step-up cannot be applied more than twice or without two-quarter gap; TLR step-up cannot push required ratio above 6.00x.

candidates.title: Add-back cap percent is instrument-specific
candidates.assertion: Must not apply CONMED 15% or DSGR 20% Combined Cap or GIB 1.10 caps interchangeably.

candidates.title: ECF step-down ≠ leverage step-up
candidates.assertion: GIB ECF prepay % step-down must not be modeled as CONMED Material Acquisition leverage step-up.

candidates.title: Cure Amount label ≠ equity cure
candidates.assertion: Riot Cure Amount (BTC) must never be routed into EBITDA equity-cure or Available Amount exclusion logic used for FWRG/CHWY ABL cures.
